name: Grace Cossington Smith
art_institution: Royal Art Society of New South Wales || Society of Artists || Contemporary Group at Adrian Feint's Grosvenor Gallery || Macquarie Galleries
style: Modernist depiction of Sydney cafeteria, paintings of the arch of the Sydney Harbour Bridge, indoor scenes of doorways and windows with yellow as dominant colour
theme: Sydney landscapes, still lifes, interiors, doorways and window sills, important events such as World Wars, arrival of Prince of Wales
color: Bright shimmering colour filled with reflected sunlight, cool colours added to shadows, square brush strokes with bright unblended colours
composition: Carefully placed brush strokes of brilliant colour side by side to build up small squares, building form in colour
